items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 17 at 2:54PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A low in the Gulf of Alaska will will bring a front to the Alaska
Range and Central Interior Tuesday and Wednesday. There is
uncertainty with the exact strength and placement of this front
and we are currently expecting around 3 to 6 inches of snow from
the Western Alaska Range to Fairbanks. However, there is a 30%
chance for snow accumulations exceeding 6 inches in this area.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 17 at 1:51PM AKDT until October 20 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Monday to 4 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects and make
travel difficult. Light snow could lead to areas of blowing snow,
reducing visibility at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Following strong southerly winds north of
Trims Camp on Monday, moderate to heavy snow is expected to build
in late Monday through Wednesday
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Storm Watch issued October 17 at 1:47PM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow possible. Total snow accumulations between 5 and
10 inches possible.

* WHERE...Upper Chena River Valley, White Mountains and Eagle Summit.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Gusty winds could lead to
areas of blowing snow which could reduce visibility below one half
mile at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Northwest wind gusts may be as high as 35 mph
Tuesday morning into early Wednesday morning.
items.areas: White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River; Upper Chena River Valley
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts for updates on this situation.

items.headline: Winter Storm Watch issued October 17 at 1:47PM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow possible. Total snow accumulations between 5 and
10 inches possible.

* WHERE...Delta Junction, Fortymile Country, and Upper Tanana Valley.

* WHEN...From Monday evening through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Northwest wind gusts may be as high as 35 mph
Tuesday morning into early Wednesday morning.
items.areas: Fortymile Country; Upper Tanana Valley; Delta Junction
